name: 111. Claude Opus 5.5 request surface (opus-5-5)
description: Claude Opus 5.5 changed the request surface in ways that 400 if forwarded unchanged, verified against the live Claude API: thinking:{"type":"disabled"} and thinking:{"type":"enabled"} are rejected at every effort level (Opus 5 accepts disabled at effort high or below); forced tool_choice "any"/"tool" is rejected, on count_tokens too; and computer use accepts only computer_toolset_20260801 - both computer_20251124 and computer_20250124 are rejected on the Claude API and Google Cloud, while AWS and Foundry still serve the dated tool. A toolset entry carries no name and no display_* geometry, its calls return under member names (screenshot, left_click) tagged with toolset_name, and that tag must appear on both halves of a call/result pair or neither - a half-preserved pair is a 400 in either direction. These cases assert the OUTBOUND body via x-bf-send-back-raw-request, so they pin Bifrost's rewrite rather than merely that upstream accepted the request.

exec: pm.test('stream completed without an upstream rejection', function () {

pm.test('content_block_start for a member call carries toolset_name', function () {
pm.expect(cb.toolset_name, 'streamed member call lost toolset_name: ' + payload).to.eql('computer');
pm.expect(seen, 'no tool_use content_block_start in the stream: ' + pm.response.text().slice(0, 400)).to.be.above(0);
